source_row.rationale: Just-in-time training provides brief, focused education immediately before a task is performed, reinforcing specific, relevant knowledge or skills at the point of highest relevance and retention, particularly valuable for infrequently performed procedures or equipment where skill decay between uses is a concern.
source_row.source_detail: Point-of-need reinforcement is used to refresh specific teamwork/clinical skills close to application; TeamSTEPPS implementation resources; accessed 2026-08-14.
